en: A color illustration of a lively market square surrounded by historic multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs. Numerous stalls with white umbrellas fill the square, and vendors in traditional dress sell flowers and produce. In the center stands a large monument with a statue on a high pedestal, and in the background, on a hill, there is a prominent clock tower with a pointed roof. German writing is visible on the facades of the buildings.
